description: Stage 2 route R1 and control C (configs/teacher_train300.json training_plan): the base backbone hfl/chinese-roberta-wwm-ext trained directly on the 300 teacher chapters of weak build 20261004-teacher300 (setting T = Opus teacher labels, R1; setting W = the weak S3 labels of the same chapters, C). Schedule set for 300 chapters before any run: max_epochs 20 (about 1880 planned steps), dev (31 answered dev chapters) scored every epoch, patience 6, lr 3e-5, batch 16, grad_accumulation 1; the checkpoint rule is unchanged (best dev micro F1, ties earlier) and metrics.json records sufficiency; a flagged run is re-run under a longer schedule and both are recorded. Nothing is tuned on dev2 or the tests. Compared on dev2 by the pairs and rules in configs/teacher_train300.json.

arms.T: R1 (teacher labels of the 300 chapters, base trained directly)
arms.W: C (weak S3 labels of the same 300 chapters, control)

backbone.download_note: pytorch_model.bin 411,578,458 bytes plus small tokenizer files (about 412 MB); no safetensors in the repo

planned_steps_note: about 1500 windows / 16 = about 94 steps per epoch x 20 epochs = about 1880 planned steps (S3 on 749 chapters planned 1410); dev scored every epoch, patience 6
